title: Indiana Code Title 6, Article 3.6 (Local Income Taxes)
verified_how: Not verified on the register on 2026-10-20 (no permitted route). Article number and name from general knowledge: IC 6-3.6 is the local income tax that replaced the earlier county taxes (CAGIT, COIT and CEDIT) from 2017; county rates are set by local ordinance.
notes: The county rate each resident (and some nonresidents who work in a county) pays on top of the state adjusted gross income tax in IC 6-3; it uses the same Indiana adjusted gross income base. Unverified (general knowledge).
